subject: Authorization: Offer for Senior Governance & Security Engineer
messages:
From: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
To: evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com, k.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-08-25T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Headcount request + approval to extend offer — Senior GovSec Engineer

Team,

Following our on-site loop, Marissa recommends Daniel White for the Senior Governance & Security Engineer role (IC5). Fast summary:
- Candidate: Daniel White (ex-CloudSec at NovaBank)
- Target start: 2026-10-05
- Headcount: incremental HC approved in HRREQ-1234 (attached)
- Recommended comp: Band GRC-4 (see comp-band-2026-GRC.xlsx attached). Proposed package: $170k base, 12% bonus, 0.12% RSU annualized (4-yr).

Requests:
1) Formal authorization to extend an offer at up to the band midpoint + 5% (i.e., up to $178,500 base) if counteroffer pressure arises.
2) Sign-off on one-time sign-on of $5k and relocation stipend up to $3k if needed.
3) Approval to send offer via DocuSign and set a 72-hour acceptance window.

Attachments: headcount-req-1234.pdf, comp-band-2026-GRC.xlsx, draft offer letter (attached).

If I don’t hear objections by 11:00am PT I’ll ask Recruiting to issue the formal offer.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Talent Operations
Redwood Inference
From: evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-08-25T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Headcount request + approval to extend offer — Senior GovSec Engineer

Laura,

Thanks for the quick write-up. I approve authorizing an offer to Daniel within the GRC-4 band, with flexibility up to midpoint +5% as requested. A couple of asks before you send:
- Please confirm total OTE (base + target bonus) and burn rate against this quarter’s headcount budget so Finance can reconcile.
- Include the one-time sign-on amount in the offer template and flag it in Workday for payroll.

Assume aligned on the 72-hour acceptance window unless Recruiting requests otherwise.

Evelyn
VP, People Operations
From: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-08-25T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Headcount request + approval to extend offer — Senior GovSec Engineer

Laura / Evelyn,

I’m confirming: please move forward. Daniel is strong on governance programs (led SOC2 scoping at NovaBank) and has the exact audit remediation experience we need. I recommend we start at $172,000 base (slightly above midpoint) with the $5k sign-on; that keeps total comp competitive but within band.

Operational notes for Offer and onboarding:
- Must include standard security clause for privileged access and mandatory 30-day security onboarding (training + sprint shadowing).
- Background check and export control screening required prior to start.
- Hiring manager will own on-call rotation details; provide expected pager frequency in the offer appendix.

Attached is the completed offer letter (offer-Sr-GovSec-Engineer-DWhite-20260825.pdf). Recruiting: please generate DocuSign with these fields and set expiry to 72 hours.

– Marissa
Head of Governance & Compliance (interim)
Redwood Inference
From: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
To: susan@greentreetalent.com, daniel.white@gmail.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com, mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-08-25T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Offer: Senior Governance & Security Engineer (Daniel White) — please review and send DocuSign

Susan / Daniel,

Attached is the authorized offer for Daniel White (Senior Governance & Security Engineer). Summary of the offer being issued now:
- Base: $172,000
- Bonus: 12% target
- RSU: 0.12% annualized (4-yr vesting)
- One-time sign-on: $5,000
- Relocation stipend: up to $3,000 (if used)
- Start date: tentative 2026-10-05

Please generate the DocuSign packet and send to Daniel with a 72-hour expiry. Note to Recruiting: prioritize candidate communications — if candidate pushes for higher base, escalate to Laura and Marissa immediately (use Evelyn for final approvals if needed).

Daniel — congratulations. If you have any questions about the offer language or start logistics please reply directly to Susan and me. We ask for signature via DocuSign within 72 hours to secure the spot.

Attachments: offer-Sr-GovSec-Engineer-DWhite-20260825.pdf, comp-band-2026-GRC.xlsx

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Talent Operations
Redwood Inference

To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Laura / Marissa,

Approve the offer with the following carve-outs to be included in final paperwork: 
- Explicit access control clause for privileged systems and requirement to complete role-based access review within 30 days of start.
- Conditioned on successful background screen and export control check. If either fails, offer is rescinded.
- Please add expected on-call commitment (NOC roster) to the onboarding appendix.

Once those items are in the DocuSign draft I’m comfortable with the hire.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
